Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.yaml

Class YamlBrainHumanoidEntity

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity.Entity
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity.BrainEntity
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity.HumanoidBrainEntity
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.yaml.YamlBrainHumanoidEntity
All Implemented Interfaces:
BehaviorTriggers, WebSocket.Listener, org.bukkit.event.Listener
public class YamlBrainHumanoidEntity extends HumanoidBrainEntity implements BehaviorTriggers
A YAML-configured HumanoidBrainEntity.

Selected by YamlEntityLoader when the entity definition has type: "BrainHumanoid". The brain is configured from the same EntityDefinition fields already used by YamlHumanoidEntity, so existing config authors have nothing new to learn about skin or attribute fields. The only new field is ai_type, which selects which goals are registered:

  • "LookAndWander" (default) — looks at nearby players, wanders when idle.
  • Additional presets can be added to configurePreset(java.lang.String, com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.beta.MannequinBrain, org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) over time without changing the loader.

YAML example: 

 id: village_elder
 type: BrainHumanoid
 ai_type: LookAndWander
 name:
   text: Village Elder
   color: "#ffdd88"
 skin:
   displayName: village_elder
   UUID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
   textureValue: "ewogI..."
   textureSignature: "abc..."
 attributes:
   - attribute: MAX_HEALTH
     value: 30
